feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Nearly four million in destitution across UK, study suggests
articles.summary: The number of people in destitution across the UK is at a record level, according to new research, as approximately 3.8 million struggled to access basic necessities last year.

articles.title: Illicit substances found in one in eight vapes seized from students
articles.summary: One in eight vapes seized in schools by the Metropolitan Police contained illicit drugs including spice and THC, a new operation has shown.

articles.title: Victims failed at every step of criminal justice system - report
articles.summary: Victims of crime are being failed at every step of the criminal justice system, a major new report has warned.

articles.title: Restaurateur and sister cleared of murdering their 100-year-old mother
articles.summary: A restaurateur and his sister have been cleared of murdering their 100-year-old mother with morphine.

articles.title: Capita shares at 35-year low as firm counts cost of civil service pension failures
articles.summary: Capita shares plunged more than 70% on Monday after the UK-based outsourcer revealed plans for a cash call amid an expected slump in profits linked to its troubled Civil Service pension scheme contract.

articles.title: Hacker sentenced for leaking Grand Theft Auto VI clips
articles.summary: A man who hacked into the makers of Grand Theft Auto and leaked clips after stealing 90 gameplay videos from the sixth installment has been sentenced.

articles.title: Man charged with raping woman on Brighton beach
articles.summary: A 28-year-old man has been charged with raping a woman on Brighton beach in the summer.
